class.name: TextureAtlas
class.brief_description: A sprite sheet with named regions of any size.

method.name: clear_regions
method.description: Removes all regions. [AtlasTexture]s handed out before keep their last values.

method.name: create_sprite_frames
method.description: Builds a [SpriteFrames] resource from the regions whose names start with [param prefix]. The animation name is the region name without its trailing number and without a trailing [code]_[/code], [code]-[/code], [code].[/code] or space: [code]walk_0[/code], [code]walk_1[/code] and [code]walk_10[/code] become the animation [code]walk[/code]. If nothing is left (for example with the prefix [code]walk_[/code]), the prefix without its separator is used. Frames are sorted by their number in numeric order ([code]walk_2[/code] before [code]walk_10[/code]); regions without a number become one-frame animations. Every animation plays at [param fps] frames per second and loops. The frames are the [AtlasTexture]s of [method get_texture], so they stay linked to the atlas. The animation [code]"default"[/code] is removed unless a region produces it. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var frames = atlas.create_sprite_frames("hero_", 12.0) $Hero.sprite_frames = frames $Hero.play("hero_walk") [/gdscript] [csharp] SpriteFrames frames = atlas.CreateSpriteFrames("hero_", 12.0); hero.SpriteFrames = frames; hero.Play("hero_walk"); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: get_region
method.description: Returns the rectangle of the region [param name] in pixels of [member texture]. Prints an error and returns an empty [Rect2i] if the region does not exist.

method.name: get_region_count
method.description: Returns the number of regions.

method.name: get_region_margin
method.description: Returns the margin of the region [param name] (see [method set_region_margin]). Prints an error and returns an empty [Rect2i] if the region does not exist.

method.name: get_region_names
method.description: Returns the names of all regions, in insertion order.

method.name: get_texture
method.description: Returns the [AtlasTexture] of the region [param name]: its [member AtlasTexture.atlas] is [member texture], its [member AtlasTexture.region] the rectangle of the region, its [member AtlasTexture.margin] the margin of the region and its [member AtlasTexture.filter_clip] the value of [member filter_clip]. The texture is created on the first call and then returned again for the same name, so it can be compared and shared. It is updated whenever [member texture], [member filter_clip], the region or its margin changes, and it follows [method rename_region]. If the region is removed, the texture keeps its last values. Prints an error and returns [code]null[/code] if the region does not exist.

method.name: has_region
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a region named [param name] exists.

method.name: import_texture_packer_json
method.description: Replaces all regions with the frames of a TexturePacker JSON file, in the Hash ([code]"frames": {...}[/code]) or Array ([code]"frames": [...][/code]) layout. [code]meta.image[/code] becomes the texture path; a relative path is resolved against [param base_dir] (usually the folder of the JSON file). Frame file names become region names: an image extension is removed and slashes, backslashes, [code]:[/code] and [code]"[/code] become [code]_[/code] (see [method texture_packer_name_to_region_name]). Trimmed frames keep their original size: the offset and the size difference become the margin of the region ([method set_region_margin]). Rotated frames are not supported and make the import fail with an error that names the frame. Multi-texture files ([code]"textures"[/code]) are not supported.

method.name: is_valid_region_name
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param name] can be used as a region name: not empty, no [code]/[/code], [code]:[/code] or [code]"[/code], no control characters and no leading or trailing spaces.

method.name: load_from_csv
method.description: Replaces the texture and all regions with the content of a CSV text in the layout described in the class description. The column names may be in any order and case. See [method load_from_json] for how the texture is resolved.

method.name: load_from_file
method.description: Reads the file at [param path] and loads it by its extension: [code].json[/code] with [method load_from_json], or with [method import_texture_packer_json] if the JSON object has a [code]frames[/code] key (relative image paths are resolved against the folder of the file), [code].csv[/code] with [method load_from_csv] and [code].ini[/code] with [method load_from_ini]. Returns [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED] for other extensions.

method.name: load_from_ini
method.description: Replaces the texture and all regions with the content of an INI text in the layout described in the class description. The first section [code][Atlas][/code] holds the texture path; every other section is a sprite. See [method load_from_json] for how the texture is resolved.

method.name: load_from_json
method.description: Replaces the texture and all regions with the content of a JSON text in the layout described in the class description, keeping the order of [code]AtlasImages[/code]. The texture path is stored in [member texture_path]. If it equals [member texture_path] or the resource path of the current [member texture], the current texture is kept; otherwise it is loaded with [method ResourceLoader.load] (any path the engine can load, including [code]uid://[/code] and path prefixes such as [code]mods://[/code]). A missing [code]TexturePath[/code], a texture that cannot be loaded, an invalid name or a region outside the texture is an error; the atlas is then not changed.

method.name: remove_region
method.description: Removes the region [param name]. The [AtlasTexture] handed out before for it keeps its last values.

method.name: rename_region
method.description: Renames the region [param from] to [param to]. The region keeps its position in the order and its [AtlasTexture]. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if [param from] does not exist, [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] if [param to] exists, and [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [param to] is not a valid name.

method.name: save_as_csv
method.description: Returns the atlas as CSV text in the layout described in the class description. The margin columns are written only if at least one region has a margin. The texture path is written as described in [method save_as_json].

method.name: save_as_ini
method.description: Returns the atlas as INI text in the layout described in the class description. The texture path is written as described in [method save_as_json].

method.name: save_as_json
method.description: Returns the atlas as JSON text in the layout described in the class description, with the regions in their order. [param indent] is the indentation per level; an empty string writes one line. [code]TexturePath[/code] is [member texture_path] if it is set; otherwise the [code]uid://[/code] path of [member texture] if the texture has a UID, otherwise its resource path.

method.name: save_to_file
method.description: Writes the atlas to [param path] in the layout of its extension: [code].json[/code], [code].csv[/code] or [code].ini[/code]. Returns [constant ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED] for other extensions.

method.name: set_region
set_region_margin
method.description: Sets the margin of the region [param name], used as [member AtlasTexture.margin] of its texture: [member Rect2i.position] is the offset of the region inside the original sprite, [member Rect2i.size] the size the original sprite is larger than the region. This restores the original size of trimmed sprites. All values must be [code]0[/code] or greater.

method.name: texture_packer_name_to_region_name
method.description: Returns the region name used for a TexturePacker frame file name: [code]"hero/walk_01.png"[/code] becomes [code]"hero_walk_01"[/code]. Image extensions ([code]png[/code], [code]jpg[/code], [code]jpeg[/code], [code]webp[/code], [code]bmp[/code], [code]tga[/code], [code]gif[/code], [code]svg[/code], [code]ktx[/code], [code]dds[/code]) are removed; slashes, backslashes, [code]:[/code] and [code]"[/code] become [code]_[/code].

members.member: Value of [member AtlasTexture.filter_clip] for every texture of [method get_texture]. If [code]true[/code], the area outside a region is clipped to avoid bleeding of the surrounding pixels.
The margins of the regions that have one (see [method set_region_margin]). Setting this property resets all other margins to zero; names of unknown regions are ignored with an error.

The regions: sprite name to rectangle [code](x, y, width, height)[/code] in pixels of [member texture], in insertion order. Setting this property replaces all regions; invalid entries are skipped with an error. Regions that keep their name keep their margin and their [AtlasTexture]. [b]Note:[/b] The returned dictionary is a copy. Use [method set_region] and [method remove_region] to change single regions.

The sprite sheet of this atlas. Any [Texture2D] works ([CompressedTexture2D] of an imported image, [ImageTexture], [GradientTexture2D], [NoiseTexture2D], another [AtlasTexture], ...). Changing it updates every texture of [method get_texture] and clears [member texture_path]. Regions outside a new, smaller texture are kept and reported in one error. [b]Note:[/b] Drawing never reads pixels. Only editor features such as thumbnails need [method Texture2D.get_image] to return an image.

The texture path read from the last loaded text file, written back unchanged by [method save_as_json], [method save_as_csv] and [method save_as_ini], so paths with a prefix such as [code]mods://[/code] or [code]uid://[/code] round-trip as text. Empty if [member texture] was set from code.
